authority: Current human request: accuracy tests use GSM8K, HumanEval and MMLU; run smoke before full evaluation. This overrides old automation task lists for NEW experiments only.
supersedes_for_new_experiments: LongBench-v2/GSM8K task set in R113 and older goal/heartbeat text

acceptance.conservative_admission: Require both <=1 percentage point and <=1 relative percent loss per task until explicitly narrowed; report both; never apply to intermediate tensors.

GSM8K.full_split: official test; revision and exact item list to freeze before launch

HumanEval.metric: pass@1 under identical deterministic generation and frozen evaluator
HumanEval.full_split: all official problems for the frozen dataset revision; no cherry-picked omissions
HumanEval.execution_safety: Generated code must run in a separate nonprivileged no-network/no-NPU sandbox, no secrets or broad host mounts, one temporary write directory, with CPU/RAM/time/process limits. Scorer and extraction must be frozen.

MMLU.metric: accuracy, with all subjects and aggregate weighting explicitly reported
MMLU.smoke_proposed: two deterministically selected test items per subject, separate from any tuning set
MMLU.full_split: all official test subjects for the frozen revision
MMLU.prompt_scoring_pending: Freeze few-shot count, prompt template, answer extraction versus loglikelihood scoring before any launch; do not mix protocols.

generation.EOS: normal; do not force 1024 for task evaluation
generation.scope: Generative tasks. Any non-generative MMLU scoring choice must be explicitly registered, not silently equated.

smoke_purpose: early obvious task regression or truncation detection
remaining_scope: Preparation only until actual source/data/evaluator/sandbox/consumer prerequisites and budget fit are verified.
